evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date, and a datetime string was rejected.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-10-02"} returned 200 with the new date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and "2026-10-15T10:00:00Z" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: With today = 2026-10-15, GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the open todo due 2026-10-01. A todo due today, a todo due in the future, a todo with no date and a done todo with a past date were all overdue:false. They appeared under ?overdue=false and not under ?overdue=true.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed each due date: 'past 2026-10-01 überfällig', 'future 2026-12-01', 'today 2026-10-15', 'donepast ✓ 2026-09-01'. The todo with no date showed none.
evidence.AC6: Only the open todo with a past due date showed the word 'überfällig'. The todos due today, in the future, without a date, and the done todo with a past date had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. Checking it reduced the list to only 'past 2026-10-01 überfällig'.
